name: CSS Animation Runtime Adapter
summary: Author CSS keyframe motion with delay and fill behavior that remains deterministic under HyperFrames seeking.
problem: Wall-clock CSS animations are difficult to reproduce at arbitrary video timestamps unless their timing is controlled by the renderer.
coreOutcomes: Configure CSS keyframes for deterministic frame seeking
Apply delay, fill mode and playback state correctly
Translate CSS motion patterns into render-safe HyperFrames HTML
requirements: CSS keyframe animation support in the browser
boundaries: Covers CSS animation integration, not general visual direction
Avoid animation behavior that depends on an uncontrolled wall clock
